text: Button shows either "new project" or "open project" - depending on whether .bowman folder exists

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; needs acceptance in the project selection UI because no frontend runtime is currently running.

reflection: Added project.inspectPath as a read-only backend primitive that recognizes initialized, active, and archived-only .bowman graphs. Project selection performs a debounced, revision-guarded inspection of the typed path and displays Open Project for an existing graph or New Project otherwise. Verification: focused selector tests 2/2, backend tests 62/62, frontend tests 196/196, frontend production build/type-check, and git diff --check passed.
